It also names no RLS test or check for the new internal read-scope and case-pool tables in DDL34. A1 gave the Inspector all of backend/app/tests. S1 narrows that to named paths, so the shared fixtures are now an unowned dependency, and needing them would trigger S1's own 'unowned required path' stop during T1. The checks section (lines 125-131) mentions 'RLS' only in general terms and names neither verify:rls-ddl nor backend:rls-smoke. PR200-validation.md does not claim this fix, so the records and the stated delta disagree.

Line 62 gives the Engineer compatibility row the 11 frontend files 'and their colocated specs', and lines 64-68 repeat the colocated specs for the archive/audit additions without naming a role.
